services.name: Sun house tours
services.desc: Docent led tours of the historic Sun House are generally available Friday through Sunday from 12:00 to 3:00.Please call to confirm tour availability, or to inquire aboutscheduling a tour for the day you plan to visit. The Sun House, a 1911 redwood Craftsman bungalow home, is situated immediately in front of the Museum and is available for tours. Grace and John Hudson, its owners, together with architect George Wilcox, set out to build a functional, custom Craftsman-style home scaled to the Hudsons’ needs. blurb: With this 2026 exhibition we commemorate the 40th anniversary of the Grace Hudson Museum, the 150th anniversary of the City of Ukiah, and the 250th anniversary of our nation by exploring elements of the Greater Ukiah Valley - past and present - which have helped create and shape community.
